Two new knobs (the τ ramp, and the tokenizer's own noise ladder as an [Eval/…] scalar — no tc512 flow checkpoint exists, so the ladder cannot be read the way TODO 12 read it) plus an eval-only job on the twin's epoch_80.pth for the "before" ladder. The in-graph mode is removed from the code, not gated, so BSC:45529827 must not be resumed. Next arm on this question is the tc1536 no-bottleneck twin, plan/2026-09-09_tc_width_decnoise_detach_tc1536.md, not submitted. todos.item: Attack the rank ceiling directly instead of via the weight
todos.note: done: results/2026-09-06_sigreg_cov_penalty_tc512_slides.html. Four doses over one base (tc512 · compose 1.0 · sigreg 0.02): cov 0 BSC:45296347, 3e-5 BSC:45416718 (ep 72, 44 h wall), 1e-4 BSC:45498520 and 3e-4 BSC:45498521 (both cancelled 2026-09-07 at ep 29/100, 18 h of 44 h — the axis was already answered). Verdict: not worth adding. cov_weight does exactly what it was designed to do to the spectrum and almost nothing to reconstruction. Train ZPartRank is monotone in dose with no ceiling — 84.8 → 109.1 → 115.8 → 163.3 at matched ep 29, a 1.9× spread — while eval LossRecon moves a few percent and not even in dose order: on the ep 24–29 mean only 3e-5 is ahead of the control (−10.6% K / −10.6% N), 1e-4 is behind it (+8.0% / +5.3%) and 3e-4 clears the control (−6.1% / −4.9%) but not 3e-5 (+5.0% / +6.4%). This falsifies the thread's central hypothesis: participation rank is not the lever on reconstruction. The r = −0.997 … −0.999 rank↔recon correlation that motivated the term held across arms that differed in convergence, and it breaks the moment rank is pushed directly at a fixed recipe — 1.9× the rank buys nothing. Rank stays a diagnostic, never a target. No dose reached the 0.0528 K / 0.0370 N weight-axis best either, so the plateau confound of TODO 2 is not settled and was not settled by this route. Left open: slides 1–10 of the deck still carry the earlier ep-67 3e-5 reading ("a new best, narrowly") and disagree with slide 11 — the ep-29 dose axis is the one to quote. §4–5 of plan/2026-09-02_sigreg_cov_penalty.md were written under the old reading and carry a reversal note. Both cancelled current.pth are resumable at ep 29 if the axis is ever revisited; the 3e-4 late-crossing question is dropped, not measured.

todos.item: Decoder-only noise-augmented finetune of the tc128 compose tokenizer (RAE noise_tau), read through the unchanged flow control
todos.paper: main results: tokenizer for the flow eval
todos.note: done: results/2026-09-06_flow_decoder_noise_finetune_slides.html. BSC:45421190 (10-epoch decoder-only finetune of the tc128 compose tokenizer, decode_noise_tau=0.8 + freeze_except_decoder=true, warm-started weights-only from compose1.0/ckpts/epoch_100.pth) plus the eval jobs BSC:45497311/19, 45497830/31 and the N-sweep BSC:45498382. Every design check held: MSEToken reproduces 0.6677 / 0.8850 to the digit, so encode() is bit-identical and only the decoder moved; the σ=0 round trip improved 1.3–1.7%. The ladder flattens outright — σ=0.82 raymap 19.09 → 1.67, so the superlinear knee below MSE 0.30 is gone. Best achievable against best achievable: raymap −17.6%, pointmap −9.1%, with the sampler optimum moving N=2 → N=20 and −35.5% raymap at matched N=20. The one loss is N=1 (+17.7% raymap): at the same latent error magnitude, isotropic noise now decodes 3.5× better than the flow's own error, so the 1-step error is structured, not isotropic — the probe's framing inverts. epoch_10 replaces epoch_100 as the tokenizer every flow read uses. Leads to TODO 13, in tc_width: end-to-end decoder-noise training of the tc512 compose tokenizer (plan/2026-09-07_tc_width_decnoise_e2e_tc512.md, BSC:45529827). Falsifier 3 routed it out of flow: fixing the decoder alone cannot change a code it is not allowed to touch, so the pair needs a from-scratch noisy tokenizer with the encoder in the graph — which changes z and is a tc_width/sigreg question. Left open, but not queued: the N=20 penalty in plan/2026-09-04_flow_bestofk_regressor_null.md is at least partly a decoder artifact and was never re-read on epoch_10 — TODO 11 was dropped 2026-09-07 as not needed.

Left open, but not queued: the N=20 penalty in `plan/2026-09-04_flow_bestofk_regressor_null.md` is at least partly a decoder artifact and was never re-read on `epoch_10` — TODO 11 was dropped 2026-09-07 as `not needed`.
